Game distribution

Zhejiang Changtang · 2025–present

Context

02

Music discovery

Music taxonomy and country-specific content pools

Chuanyi Hulian · 2023–2024

Context

Music from different rights holders arrived with inconsistent labels. African markets also required a more local understanding of genres, artists and listening preferences.

My contribution

Rebuilt a classified, tiered tag system and rights-holder mappings. Established algorithmic tag production and country-specific content pools. Created a feedback loop for incorrect artist associations.

Outcome: more accurate labels and content associations, supporting playlist discovery and playback.

03

Content operations

Accompaniment library, audio algorithms and search

NetEase Cloud Music · 2019–2023

Context

An accompaniment library needs reliable ingestion and structured metadata to support karaoke, search and content discovery across products.

My contribution

Built the ingestion workflow from the ground up. Introduced crawling and preprocessing, coordinated audio algorithms and data acceptance, and worked with search teams on queries and metadata. Led the audio operations team.

Supported the Yinjie app, in-app karaoke, lyrics, audio quality, music encyclopedia and specialist content areas.
